title: Qualcomm’s $300 laptops will be netbooks, not Neo competitors.
summary: The budget laptops are obviously not powerhouses, especially with Qualcomm positioning them against Intel N250 devices instead of Intel’s Core lineup or the MacBook Neo’s A18 Pro chip .
